desc: Ideate and establish the canonical structure: common zeros never flip, mandatory bits flip at most once, common ones flip at most twice, all 1->0 flips precede all 0->1 flips, 1->0 order descending C, 0->1 order ascending C, and for a fixed k the best common ones are the k largest C.

Implement the final Python program using the top-k scan formula: partition D/U/P, sort P descending, compute pm(D), pm(U), maintain pm(D∪S), pm(U∪S) with query(x)=sum_{y<x}y + x*count_{y>=x} plus x*(k-1), evaluate F(k)=(m+2k)*(Psum-sumS)+sumU+sumS+pmD+pmU, and print the minimum.
Validate the implementation with sample tests and the brute-force checker; final code reads stdin and writes the answer to stdout.
